scenario: Deploy current API: DEPLOYING then DEPLOYED, then invocable
steps: Deploy via control plane; poll deployment status; invoke
expected_result: Status DEPLOYED after gateway ack; gateway returns 200

scenario: Undeploy: UNDEPLOYED and gateway stops serving
Restore an archived deployment brings back the previous behaviour
expected_result: Gateway routes to backend X again; deployment 1 DEPLOYED, deployment 2 ARCHIVED
notes: Rollback is a coverage gap today

scenario: Deploying a saved build ignores later edits to the API
expected_result: Gateway serves the build snapshot, not the edited API

scenario: Deploy-time metadata overrides (endpointUrl, vhostMain, vhostSandbox) take effect
steps: Deploy with overrides; call with the main and sandbox Host headers
expected_result: Requests route to the override endpoint and the right vhost

scenario: Gateway offline at deploy time: deployment does not report success and times out
steps: Deploy; wait past deployments.duration; start gateway
expected_result: Status stays DEPLOYING then resolves to FAILED (or DEPLOYED once the gateway acks after reconnect, as documented)
notes: Short timeout overlay keeps the test fast

scenario: Gateway rejects an artifact: deployment FAILED with the gateway reason
preconditions: API with a policy the gateway cannot load
expected_result: Status FAILED; statusReason carries the gateway error code; previous deployment keeps serving

scenario: Per-gateway deployment limit and build limit
steps: Deploy past max_per_api_gateway; create builds past max_builds_per_api
expected_result: Oldest unused build evicted, else refused; deployment limit refused with a clear reason

scenario: Gateway release too old for the artifact kind is refused
steps: Deploy an agent proxy or GraphQL API
expected_result: Deploy refused up front with a version reason; no event sent

scenario: Undeploy from one of two gateways leaves the other serving
preconditions: API deployed to GW1 and GW2

steps: Scenario outline over GraphQL API, LLM provider, LLM proxy, MCP proxy, agent proxy: create, deploy, invoke, undeploy
expected_result: Each kind reaches DEPLOYED, answers through the gateway, then 404 after undeploy
